```

The test `pandas.tests.io.excel.test_writers.TestExcelWriter.test_write_subset_columns()` is checking whether writing and then reading back a DataFrame with subset columns works correctly. The failing AssertionError suggests that the shape of the expected DataFrame ([left]: (3, 2)) does not match the shape of the read DataFrame ([right]: (3, 3)). This implies that while writing, the subset columns are not being preserved properly.
